identity.title: Blocking Assets and Prohibiting Transactions With Significant Narcotics Traffickers

boundaries: Order-specific two-page PDF: section3 definitions cross fromp1top2; sections4–6 and signature/date onp2, literal ANNEX after signature/date/first billingcode and beforeFRDoc. No neighboring substantive instrument on supplied pages.

inventory.quote: I, WILLIAM J. CLINTON, President of the United States of America, find that the actions of significant foreign narcotics traffickers centered in Colombia, and the unparalleled violence, corruption, and harm that they cause in the United States and abroad, constitute an unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security, foreign policy, and economy of the United States, and hereby declare a national emergency to deal with that threat.
inventory.source_first_reading: Finding and declaration have operative content; authority recital before them is context.

inventory.quote: I hereby order blocked all property and interests in property that are or hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States persons, of:
inventory.source_first_reading: Qualified by IEEPA203(b), regulations/orders/directives/licenses under order, notwithstanding prior contract/license/permit. Blocking scope includes annex persons and designated classes.

inventory.quote: the foreign persons listed in the Annex to this order;
inventory.source_first_reading: Annex incorporation makes named membership legally material. Signature placement does not make annex extraneous.

inventory.quote: foreign persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Attorney General and the Secretary of State:
inventory.source_first_reading: Determinations: significant role in international narcotics trafficking centered in Colombia OR materially assisting/providing financial or technological support/goods/services supporting narcotics trafficking activities of persons designated in or pursuant to order.

inventory.quote: persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Attorney General and the Secretary of State, to be owned or controlled by, or to act for or on behalf of, persons designated in or pursuant to this order.
inventory.source_first_reading: Separate controlled/acting-for class, not limited by its wording to foreign persons.

Same statutory/regulatory/license qualifications and notwithstanding-prior-contract/license/permit clause. Prohibits (a) any transaction/dealing by US persons or within US in property/interests of persons designated in/pursuant to order; (b) any transaction by US person or withinUS that evades/avoids, has purpose of evading/avoiding, or attempts to violate any order prohibition.

inventory.quote: For the purposes of this order:
inventory.source_first_reading: Definitions person=individual/entity; entity=partnership, association, corporation or other organization/group/subgroup; UnitedStatesperson=US citizen/national/permanent-resident alien/entity organized under US law(including foreign branches)/any person inUS; foreignperson=foreign citizen/national(including dualUS) or entity not solely organized/existing under USlaw, excludes foreign state; narcoticstrafficking=illicit cultivation/production/manufacture/distribution/sale/finance/transport or other assistance/abetting/conspiracy/collusion in illicit activities relating to narcotic drugs includingnotlimited cocaine.

inventory.quote: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Attorney General and the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA as may be necessary to carry out this order.
inventory.source_first_reading: Also Treasury may redelegate any functions to other USgovernment officers/agencies; all USgovernment agencies directed to take appropriate measures within their authority to carryout order. All three components material.

inventory.quote: Nothing contained in this order shall create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable by any party against the United States, its agencies or instrumentalities, its officers or employees, or any other person.
inventory.source_first_reading: Noncreation/enforceability limitation; must retain in source understanding.

inventory.quote: This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time on October 22, 1995.
inventory.source_first_reading: Express effective instant, not signature/publication date.

inventory.quote: This order shall be transmitted to the Congress and published in the Federal Register.
inventory.source_first_reading: Separate transmittal and publication directions; source shows publication but does not alone establish congressional transmittal.
